{{Quote|G&hellip; Gerlun&hellip;?!|Demtri's final words|<ref name="Legacy 27" />}}
'''Demtri''', [[Gender/Legends|brother]] of [[Gerlun]], was a member of the [[Malevolence (cult)|Malevolence]], a [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] cult that lived in [[Andeddu's Keep]] on [[Prakith/Legends|Prakith]]. When [[Darth Wyyrlok (III)|Darth Wyyrlok III]] appeared at the Keep to learn [[Darth Andeddu]]'s secrets, Demtri and the other Dark Jedi [[Mission to Prakith (Darth Wyyrlok)|confronted]] the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]]. They were, however, no match for Wyyrlok's mastery of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] and, under the influence of a [[Mind trick/Legends|Force illusion]] of multiple Wyyrloks, Gerlun [[Death/Legends|struck down]] Demtri.<ref name="Legacy 27" />
